data.notes: March 2026 skewed toward arena and theater-scale touring shows in Rio, with a smaller but active underground electronic calendar around Centro, Vidigal, and Trauma.

events.title: Macy Gray - Rio de Janeiro
events.summary: Macy Gray brought her Turnê de Verão 2026 to Vivo Rio, with the source listing a March 5 show at 21:30. The billing focused on her soul/R&B catalog, including a full-album presentation of On How Life Is.

events.title: Bryan Adams - World: Roll With The Punches
events.summary: Bryan Adams’ official tour page listed Qualistage, Rio de Janeiro for March 6, 2026 on the World: Roll With The Punches tour. This was the Rio stop on his South American run following dates in Mexico.

events.title: Jason Mraz - Return to South America Tour
events.summary: Jason Mraz played Vivo Rio on March 6, 2026, as part of his Return to South America Tour. Ticketmaster listed doors at 19:30 and show time at 21:30.

events.title: Claudia Leitte - Turnê Intemporal
events.summary: Claudia Leitte brought the more intimate Intemporal project to Vivo Rio on March 13, 2026. The venue page lists the event with an axé classification and a 22:00 show time.

events.title: Pistuxa x Hausu no Trauma
events.summary: São Paulo party Pistuxa linked with Baixada Fluminense collective Hausu for a club night at TRAUMA in Centro. Resident Advisor listed Valesuchi b2b Lucas Kid, D.Silvestre, and Da Bomb b2b Levas from March 13 at 22:00 to March 14 at 05:00.

events.title: Guilherme Arantes - 50 Anos-Luz
events.summary: Guilherme Arantes celebrated 50 years of career with the 50 Anos-Luz tour at Vivo Rio. Ticketmaster confirmed the March 14, 2026 presentation at 22:00.

events.title: Alceu Valença - 80 Girassóis
events.summary: Alceu Valença opened the Rio date of his 80 Girassóis celebration at Farmasi Arena. The venue page confirms March 14, 2026 with doors at 19:00 and show time at 21:00.

events.title: Steve Hackett & Genetics - The Best of Genesis Tour 2026
events.summary: Steve Hackett appeared with Genetics at Vivo Rio on the The Best of Genesis Tour 2026. The venue page listed March 21, 2026 at 21:00, with the show built around Genesis-era classics.

events.title: Baco Exu do Blues - HASOS Show Tour
events.summary: Baco Exu do Blues brought the HASOS Show Tour to Farmasi Arena. The venue confirmed Saturday, March 21, 2026, with doors at 20:00 and show time at 22:00.

events.title: Chicago Legacy - Danny Seraphine
events.summary: Chicago Legacy, led by founding Chicago drummer Danny Seraphine, played Qualistage in Rio. Ticketmaster listed the March 27, 2026 performance at 21:30.

events.title: As Vozes - Péricles e Ferrugem
events.summary: Péricles and Ferrugem teamed up for As Vozes at Farmasi Arena. The venue page confirmed March 28, 2026, with doors at 20:00 and show time at 22:00.

events.title: Rave In Rio - Ep8, Vidigal
events.venueName: Rua Major Toja Martinez Filho, 126 - Vidigal
events.summary: Rave In Rio returned for Ep8 in Vidigal with a lineup including Soppa, Crazy Jeff, Vazz, ZN1, and Remixia. Shotgun listed the event for March 29, 2026 from 18:00 to 02:00.
